crossRefs.note: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,
I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

translations.web: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
translations.bsb: A servant cannot be corrected by words alone; though he understands, he will not respond.
translations.kjv: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
translations.asv: A servant will not be corrected by words; For though he understand, he will not give heed.
